info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Marjoram Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Marjoram Notebook Details Submission API allows users to input and register detailed information about marjoram notebooks within the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the creation of new notebook entries, including essential specifications and features. Typical consumers include product managers and catalog administrators seeking to enhance product listings. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure accurate and up-to-date information for their marjoram notebook offerings.

post.summary: Create new details for a marjoram notebook.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details associated with a marjoram notebook, enabling effective management of the notebook's content and information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details regarding a marjoram notebook. It is expected to contain necessary information about the notebook's specifications and attributes in JSON format.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the details are returned.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the notebook.
